recognize_zh: 紅血球大小與形狀極度不一：可見標靶細胞、淚滴狀、碎片、摺疊細胞與低色素小紅血球，還有少數含深色包涵體的紅血球，這種明顯的異形紅血球症（poikilocytosis）在 β-海洋性貧血重型很常見。
features: Marked anisopoikilocytosis with numerous bizarre red cell shapes
Target cells, folded cells, teardrop cells, and red cell fragments
Hypochromic microcytes alongside larger pale cells
Occasional red cells with small dark inclusions (possible Howell-Jolly or Pappenheimer bodies)
Occasional crenated cell; platelets scattered; no leukocytes in field
describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows marked anisopoikilocytosis with hypochromic microcytes, target cells, folded cells, teardrop cells, and red cell fragments. A few red cells contain small dark inclusions compatible with Howell-Jolly or Pappenheimer bodies. Platelets are present and no leukocytes are seen in this field. Findings are consistent with severe poikilocytosis, compatible with the reported β-thalassemia major; confirmation by hemoglobin electrophoresis/HPLC is appropriate.

ddx.vs: Iron deficiency shows hypochromic microcytes and pencil cells with fewer target cells and fragments, low ferritin, and a normal HbA2.
HbH disease has a similar smear but shows golf-ball inclusions on brilliant cresyl blue supravital stain and HbH on electrophoresis.
MAHA shows schistocytes with thrombocytopenia but typically normochromic cells without the prominent target cells and hypochromia.
HPP shows elliptocytes and microspherocytes with budding fragments rather than target cells, with a normal hemoglobin pattern.
